name: simsci
description: Generic AI-assisted developer workflows for any IHME team: review-to-PR prep (a multi-agent code review that carries the fixes through to a draft PR), git rescue, commit splitting, type hinting, cross-repo regression debugging, change propagation, workflow assessment, a guided TDD development loop, and an MCP server for IHME's Jira.

jira_api_token.title: Jira personal access token
jira_api_token.description: Used by the jira MCP server. Create one in Jira under Profile > Personal Access Tokens.

jira_project.title: Default Jira project
jira_project.description: Optional. Project key, such as ABC, that the jira MCP server creates issues in when no project is given.
